recipes.content: Protein Sweet Corn Soup. Variation of Sweet Corn Soup. Asian cuisine. vegetarian recipe. Cooking time: 20 minutes. Difficulty: easy. Ingredients: 2 cups corn; 4 cups vegetable stock; 1 carrot; 1/2 cup cabbage; 1 tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp cornflour; Add 100g extra of the main protein or 1/2 cup chickpeas.. Instructions: Simmer corn and vegetables in stock. Mix cornflour with water. Add slurry and soy sauce. Cook until slightly thickened. Add 100g extra of the main protein or 1/2 cup chickpeas.
